title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
在远古荒芜时期，人们以打猎
和采食野果为生。他们不知道有火，
也不知道用火，只能吃生的食物。
所以他们经常生病，寿命也很短。
page_text_en:
In ancient times, people lived by hunting
and gathering wild fruits. They didn't know about fire,
and didn't know how to use it, so they could only eat raw food.
Therefore, they often got sick and had short lifespans.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了远古时期人们在森林中狩猎和采集野果的生活场景，文字说明他们因不懂用火而只能吃生食，导致经常生病、寿命短暂。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
有一天，一道闪电像矫健的白龙，从乌云中蹿了出来，击向大树。
“轰隆——”
雷声就像白龙的怒吼，跟闪电一道劈了下来。
“咔嚓——”
粗大的树干被雷电击断。
page_text_en:
One day, a flash of lightning, like a nimble white dragon, shot out from the dark clouds and struck a big tree.
"Boom—"
The thunder sounded like the dragon's roar, crashing down with the lightning.
"Crack—"
The thick tree trunk was shattered by the lightning.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了闪电击中大树的场景，雷声轰鸣，树干被劈断，为后续发现火种埋下伏笔。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh: 一只正在树下吃草的小鹿躲避不及，被断掉的大树干砸倒了！小鹿痛苦地哀叫起来。
page_text_en: A little deer grazing under the tree couldn't dodge in time and was knocked down by the broken tree trunk! The little deer cried out in pain.
summary_zh: 一只小鹿在树下吃草时，被闪电劈断的大树干砸中，痛苦地哀叫起来。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
噼噼！啪啪！
倒下的树枝冒起了白烟，燃起了火花，“噼噼啪啪”地烧起来。
page_text_en:
Pish! Pish! Pop! Pop!

The fallen branch gave off white smoke, sparked flames, and burned with a 'pish-pish-pop-pop' sound.
summary_zh: 闪电劈断的树枝倒下后冒烟起火，发出噼啪声，一只小鹿被砸中后惊慌逃窜。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh: “看，大树着火了！”一群人赶紧跑过来。年轻首领却捡起了一根着火的树枝。
page_text_en: "Look, the big tree is on fire!" A group of people hurried over. The young leader, however, picked up a burning branch.
summary_zh: 一群人看到大树着火后跑过来，年轻首领捡起一根着火的树枝，其他人则抬着受伤的小鹿离开。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
年轻首领盯着手上着火的树枝，乐滋滋地想：“如果让这火一直烧下去，会有什么结果呢？”
大家你看看我，我看看你，都不知道如果这个火一直着下去，会有怎样的结果。
page_text_en:
The young leader stared at the burning branch in his hand, thinking happily, 'What will happen if we let this fire burn on?'
Everyone looked at each other, not knowing what would happen if the fire kept burning.
summary_zh: 年轻首领手持着火的树枝，想象火持续燃烧的后果，其他人则面面相觑，对火的未来用途感到困惑。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
年轻首领说道：“如果每天晚上
生一个火堆，把洞口照得亮堂堂的，
野兽就不敢跑到我们住的山洞来了。”
吼吼
嗷
page_text_en:
The young leader said: "If we light a fire every night, making the cave entrance bright and clear, wild beasts won't dare come to our cave." 
Roar roar 
Aaah
summary_zh: 年轻首领手持火把，想象用火堆照亮山洞口以驱赶野兽，洞内一家三口因害怕野兽而惊恐不安，背景有野兽的吼叫声。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
于是，这群人将那根燃烧的树枝带回了山洞，又捡来一些干树枝，燃起了旺旺的火堆。
他们把肉放在火上烤，肉滋滋地流着油，溅在火上，腾起一股白烟，香味随着白烟飘进鼻子，大家饿得口水都流了出来。
所有人都吃得肚皮鼓鼓的，然后围着火堆唱歌、跳舞，直到太阳落山，月亮升上天空。
page_text_en:
Then, this group of people brought the burning branch back to the cave, gathered some dry branches, and lit a roaring fire.
They placed meat on the fire to roast. The meat sizzled, dripping oil that splashed onto the flames, rising as white smoke. The aroma drifted into their noses, and everyone drooled with hunger.
Everyone ate until their bellies were full, then gathered around the fire, singing and dancing until the sun set and the moon rose into the sky.
summary_zh: 原始人将火带回山洞，用火烤肉，享受美味，并围着火堆唱歌跳舞，庆祝火的发现。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh: 等大家都去睡觉了，年轻首领又给火堆添了些树枝。他要守护着火堆，不能让它熄灭了。月亮升上树顶的时候，年轻首领有点儿困了，他打了个哈欠，躺在了火堆旁边。
page_text_en: After everyone had gone to sleep, the young leader added some branches to the fire. He had to guard the firepile and make sure it didn't go out. When the moon rose above the treetops, the young leader felt a bit sleepy. He yawned and lay down beside the fire.
summary_zh: 年轻首领在大家入睡后为火堆添柴并守护，因困倦而躺在火堆旁休息。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
当黎明的阳光照在年轻首领的脸上时，
他猛地惊醒，坐起来看向火堆。火堆只剩下温热的灰烬，所有的树枝都烧光了。
火，灭了。
page_text_en:
When the morning sunlight fell on the young chief's face,
he suddenly woke up, sat up, and looked at the fire pile. The fire pile was left with only warm ashes, and all the branches had burned out.
The fire, gone.
summary_zh: 年轻首领在黎明时分醒来，发现昨夜点燃的火堆已经熄灭，只剩下灰烬和烧尽的树枝。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
“我一定要找到生火的方法！”年轻首领暗自发誓。
他告别族人，出发了。
他跨过九十九座山，蹚过九十九条河，可是，
火种在哪里？年轻首领继续找啊找，走啊走……
这一天，他又翻过一座山头，来到了燧明国。
page_text_en:
"I must find a way to make fire!" the young chief vowed to himself.
He bid farewell to his tribe and set off.
He crossed ninety-nine mountains, waded through ninety-nine rivers, but where was the fire seed? The young chief kept searching, walking and walking...
One day, he climbed over another mountain pass and arrived at the land of Suiming.
summary_zh: 年轻首领决心寻找生火的方法，告别族人后，历经艰难跋涉，翻山越岭，最终来到燧明国。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
燧明国的人分不清白天黑夜，辨不出春夏秋冬，因为他们从来没有见到过太阳和月亮，不知道什么是光明。
年轻首领走累了，他爬上那棵最高最大的树，躺在一根又粗又平的树枝上，美美地睡了一觉。
page_text_en:
The people of Suiming Kingdom couldn't tell day from night, or spring from winter, because they had never seen the sun or the moon, and didn't know what light was.
Tired from walking, the young leader climbed the tallest and biggest tree, lay down on a thick and flat branch, and had a lovely nap.
summary_zh: 年轻首领在燧明国爬到一棵大树上休息，因旅途疲惫而美美地睡了一觉，而当地居民从未见过光明。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
当他睡醒了，打着哈欠伸懒腰时，
被眼前的情景惊得嘴巴都合不拢。
一群羽毛发光的鸟儿，在树枝间
钻来跳去，啄虫子吃。
“笃！”每当尖利的鸟嘴啄到树木
时，树上就飞溅出了明亮的火花。
page_text_en:
When he woke up, yawning and stretching, 
he was so surprised by the scene before him that his mouth fell open.
A group of birds with glowing feathers darted among the branches, pecking for bugs.
"Duck!" Whenever the sharp bird beak pecked at the wood, 
sparks flew brightly from the tree.
summary_zh: 年轻首领在燧明国的大树上醒来，看到一群羽毛发光的鸟儿啄木时迸发出火花，感到十分惊奇。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
“这是一棵火树！”
年轻首领兴奋地捡起一根树枝，
学着火鸟的样子，在树上钻了起来。
一次，两次，三次……
树枝热了！
白烟冒了！
火苗着了！
page_text_en:
"This is a fire tree!"
The young leader excitedly picked up a branch,
imitating the fire birds, and started drilling on the tree.
Once, twice, three times...
The branch got hot!
White smoke rose!
A flame caught!
summary_zh: 年轻首领在燧明国看到火鸟啄木迸发火花后，模仿其动作钻木取火，经过多次尝试，终于成功点燃了火苗。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
page_text_ocr_zh:
用树枝钻木头就能生火，
这才是永不熄灭的火种！
年轻首领走到哪里，就
将钻木取火的方法带到哪里，
从此人们就能方便地用火了。
人们被这个年轻首领的勇气
和智慧折服，称他为“燧人”，
也就是取火者的意思。
page_text_en:
Using branches to drill wood can create fire,
this is the eternal spark!
Wherever the young leader went, he
brought the method of drilling wood to make fire,
from then on, people could easily use fire.
People were impressed by the young leader's courage
and wisdom, and called him "Sui Ren",
which means 'the one who takes fire'.
summary_zh: 年轻首领成功发明钻木取火，将方法传授给族人，人们为他的勇气和智慧所折服，称他为‘燧人’，意为取火者。

title_en: Sui Ren Drills Wood to Make Fire
summary_zh: 画面描绘了一片森林中的场景，一只成年鹿和一只小鹿正在低头吃草，周围有高大的树木和几株蓝色的小花，背景为温暖的黄色调，左上角有太阳的图案。
